utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we got a start time for the repair drive, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re still figuring it out, but I’ll check in with the organizers and let you know as soon as I hear a start time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know as soon as you hear? I’d like to plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yeah, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. I’ll bring by the tools and we can tackle whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are dropping off all sorts of useful things. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, thanks. I’m just worried about timing and where everything’s going to be stored.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around about the timing and where they’re keeping everything, then I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — I need you to bring the repair supplies to the community shed on Maple Street, ideally by 3 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring the supplies to the community shed on Maple Street by 3 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and invite a few folks I know. Let me know what time and place to tell them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll send you the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll be ready to pass it along as soon as you do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows what to bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — that helps a lot. Let me know if you want me to pass anything along to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I may take you up on that. I’ll send you a short neighbor update once the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the exact details of the repair drive, so I can make sure I get it right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m a bit late, but I can send the exact details now. What part do you need me to confirm first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start with the date, time, and location, please. I want to confirm those first so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I’ll need to work around school pickup and drop-off times. What’s the plan for today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works — let’s avoid pickup and drop-off hours and start with the kitchen repairs this morning. I’ll send you the exact time window and a short list of tasks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — send me the time window and task list, and I’ll plan around school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just heard a little about the repair drive second-hand—sounds like it’s getting organized, though I’m still catching up. What’s the latest from your side?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are pitching in with tools, donations, and a few repair teams. I’m happy to fill you in and connect you with whoever’s coordinating it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great—who should I talk to, and what are they still needing most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what you still need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I just need your final list of repairs and any photos if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in. What part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I think the biggest help is sorting the donations and making a quick list of what still needs fixing. I may be a bit scattered, but I can point you to the rest of the folks helping out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can sort the donations and make a list of what still needs fixing. Just point me to the others, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we have what folks need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let everyone know what’s happening and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’m heading out for errands soon — if you’ve got an update on the repair drive, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have a fresh update yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll check back after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask about that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need to sort the tool table and make sure the donated parts are labeled. I’ll check with everyone and repeat the plan so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I can help sort the tool table and label the parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update; what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still on for Saturday, but the drop-off spot moved to the community center lot. If you want, I can send the updated list of needed items.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo—that helps. Please send the updated list, and I’ll head to the community center lot on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Gus. Let’s keep it simple — I’ll bring the list, and we can sort out the tools before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — bring the list and we’ll make sure everything’s ready before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Mara — I’m putting together the repair drive invite list now. Want me to make sure you’re included?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please include me — I’d love to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’m happy to help connect folks if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep you posted once I know the next drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — just send me the spot and time, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, Cleo—if you send me any names or issues, I’ll get them organized right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa—I’ll send over any names and repair issues I hear about right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Cleo—I’ll keep the list updated and line up the fixes as soon as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming together, but I’m still piecing it together from the neighborhood grapevine. Did you find out what they need most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly tools and a few volunteers for the weekend shift. What time are you thinking of coming by?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m thinking Saturday morning if that still helps. I can bring a few tools too if there’s a short list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help sort the donated items and keep an eye on pickup times? I’m trying to work it around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can sort the donations and keep track of pickup times. Just send me the schedule and I’ll work around school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm you’re still able to help, and if so, can you bring a hammer or a drill?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still able to help, and I can bring a hammer and a drill.
